summary: The control-plane outbox is write-only today: every command writes its event in-transaction, then state.emit writes it again and broadcasts SSE only on the committing node; GitHub check runs bypass the outbox entirely via fire-and-forget PATCH. Two tables already planned for the fix (consumer_offsets, check_run_updates) have no readers. The proposal: write once, let a leased relay feed ordered streams, and drive GitHub from a per-job queue with isolated retries.
title: Control-plane outbox: today vs proposed
